island.backstory: A surgeon's mate who learned to fight because the wounded kept ending up on the wrong side of the boarding line. She would still rather stop a blow than land one.
island.recruitmentOffer: I have patched up better men than the ones I sail with. Take me along, Michael, and I will keep you standing long enough to finish whatever you are building.
island.companionResponse: Hold still. You have been favouring that shoulder since the reef and pretending you have not.
